api -H Accept: application/vnd.github.ra.stdout:
name: Intent Gate (shared)

# The one definition of the Intent Gate job, called by intent-gate.yml for new
# and updated pull requests and by intent-gate-retarget.yml for pull requests
# retargeted to main. The advisor pin lives only here. Read-only: nothing is
# applied, published or commented; the verdict is the check, the evidence is
# the job summary. See the advisor's PDR 0007.

on:
  workflow_call:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  gate:
    name: Declared intent
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the merge result with history
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      # The pull_request merge commit's first parent is the base as it would be
      # merged, so the comparison covers exactly what this change lands.
      - name: Resolve the compared commits
        id: commits
        run: |
          echo "base=$(git rev-parse HEAD~5)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      # Pinned by SHA: upgrading the advisor is an ordinary reviewed change here.
      - name: Compare declared intent at base and merge result
        uses: ImranAdan/infra-fleet-advisor-public/.github/actions/intent-gate@770a258a423c17ec4c3ca0cacb25b4c842eec6d0
        with:
          base-sha: ${{ steps.commits.outputs.base }}
          head-sha: ${{ steps.commits.outputs.head }}
